reason: The documentation now explicitly distinguishes documentation prototype, package source, packaged artifact, installed artifact, lifecycle gates, and validation evidence contracts. Materialization may be planned against SPEC-0001 and ADR-0043, but no source projects, package artifacts, installed artifacts, runtime implementation, publication, enablement, activation, or Campaign bindings have been created by this reconciliation.

requirementsBeforeMaterialization.requirement: Confirm topology authority: ADR-0002 remains architecture authority; ADR-0043 v0.2.0 controls concrete repository paths.
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.resolution: ADR-0002 remains authoritative for repository and solution architecture semantics. ADR-0043 v0.2.0 is authoritative for concrete current topology, project boundaries, paths, project names, and dependency layout. Where concrete topology statements conflict, ADR-0043 prevails.

requirementsBeforeMaterialization.requirement: Define mapping from docs/rule-sets/Chronicle.RuleSets.Werewolf/prototype to future rule-sets/Chronicle.RuleSets.Werewolf package source and installed rule-sets/<package-id>/<version> artifact layout.
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.evidence: SPEC-0001 installed layout versus Werewolf prototype path
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.resolution: SPEC-0001 defines documentation prototype, package source, packaged artifact, and installed artifact roles. The Werewolf prototype path remains reference evidence and is not the generic package source layout.

requirementsBeforeMaterialization.requirement: Freeze Rule Set package lifecycle states and transitions: extraction candidate, prototype candidate, implementation ready, promotion eligible, promoted, published, blocked, stale evidence.
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.resolution: Defined one shared normative Rule Set lifecycle across RFC-0027 and SPEC-0001 with states from proposed through withdrawn, allowed transitions, required evidence, transition ownership, reversibility, blocking conditions, and separation of maturity, publication, installation, and runtime activation.

requirementsBeforeMaterialization.requirement: Specify executable validation contract for package loading, reference resolution, fixtures, tests, localization, security enforcement, evidence freshness, and reconciliation.
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.resolution: SPEC-0001 defines required evidence families for structural validation, substantive review, finalized decisions, source provenance, localization, fixtures, executable tests, security, reconciliation, compatibility, migration when applicable, and promotion readiness.

requirementsBeforeMaterialization.requirement: Decide whether MVP 'complete Rule Set' means complete advertised current slice or complete source-system catalog.
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.evidence: RFC-0002/RFC-0042 complete Rule Set language versus Werewolf blocked future-slice capabilities
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.resolution: Rule Set completeness means complete declared release scope with explicit enforceable exclusions, not complete source-system implementation.

requirementsBeforeMaterialization.requirement: Document that declarative prototype artifacts do not themselves constitute the executable Rule Set package implementation.
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.evidence: prototype-work-status.json shows package-loading foundation, runtime, tests, security, and packaging phases not started.
requirementsBeforeMaterialization.resolution: SPEC-0001 states the documentation prototype is review and authoring evidence only and never executable, packaging, installation, activation, Campaign-binding, or publication authority merely because it exists in the repository.

allowedNextWork: source project materialization planning against ADR-0043 and SPEC-0001
disallowedNextWork: treat prototype decisions as source truth
